title_en: Sichuan Jufeng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. v. Dazhou Radio and Television University — dispute over a joint venture and cooperative development of real estate contract
ruling_gist_en: According to the Property Law of the People's Republic of China, a real property right shall be determined based on the content of the real property register, and the certificate of real property title is only a proof that the right holder enjoys the real property right. Where an administrative authority cancels the state-owned land use certificate but does not cancel the land registration, the user of the state-owned land is still the right holder recorded in the land registration archives. Where a transferor in a legal relationship of transfer of state-owned land use rights claims to rescind the contract on the grounds that the state-owned land use certificate has been canceled and it no longer enjoys the land use rights, the people's court shall not support such claim.

full_text_en:
Sichuan Jufeng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. v. Dazhou Radio and Television University — dispute over a joint venture and cooperative development of real estate contract

Ruling Summary

According to the provisions of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China, rights in rem over immovable property shall be determined according to the content of the real estate register, and a certificate of title to immovable property is merely a proof that the right holder enjoys such rights in rem over the immovable property. Where an administrative authority cancels a state-owned land use certificate but does not cancel the land registration, the holder of the right to use the state-owned land shall still be the right holder recorded in the land registration archives. Where in a legal relationship of transfer of the right to use state-owned land, the transferor claims rescission of the contract on the ground that its state-owned land use certificate has been cancelled and it no longer enjoys the land use right, the people's court shall not support such claim.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court

(2013) Min Yi Zhong Zi No. 18

Appellant (Plaintiff at First Instance): Sichuan Jufeng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 19, First Floor, Hongfu New Village, No. 2 North-South Trunk Road, Development Zone, Nanwai Town, Daxian County, Sichuan Province.

Legal representative: Liao Bo, General Manager of the Company.

Agent ad litem: Zhou Xin, lawyer of Sichuan Jinshida Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Zhang Xingjian, lawyer of Beijing Junzhi Law Firm.

Respondent (Defendant at First Instance): Dazhou Radio and Television University (Dazhou Finance and Trade School), domiciled at No. 183, Jinshan South Road, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province.

Legal representative: Zhang Yongxia, President of the School.

Agent ad litem: Tang Longmao, lawyer of Sichuan Fazhiyuan Law Firm.

Agent ad litem: Chen Guangjian, lawyer of Sichuan Aofei Law Firm.

The appellant, Sichuan Jufeng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jufeng Company), appealed against the civil judgment (2012) Chuan Min Chu Zi No. 11 rendered by the High People's Court of Sichuan Province on October 24, 2012 in the case of dispute with the respondent, Dazhou Radio and Television University (Dazhou Finance and Trade School) (hereinafter referred to as Dianshi Caixiao) over a joint venture and cooperative development of real estate contract. Jufeng Company, dissatisfied with the said judgment, filed an appeal to this Court. This Court formed a collegial panel according to law and held a hearing on February 28, 2013. The legal representative of Jufeng Company, Liao Bo, its agents ad litem Zhou Xin and Zhang Xingjian, and the agents ad litem of Dianshi Caixiao, Tang Longmao and Chen Guangjian, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The case has now been concluded.

The court of first instance found the following facts upon trial:

On December 7, 2001, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government issued Da Shi Fu Tu Han [2001] No. 75, the "Reply on Approving Dazhou Radio and Television University to Retroactively Complete the Procedures for Land Transfer of the Originally Allocated Land" to Dianshi Caixiao, which mainly stated that the school was approved to retroactively complete the land transfer procedures for the allocated land of 18,681.15 square meters located at the intersection of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province. The school was required to sign a land transfer contract with the Dazhou Land and Resources Bureau and apply for the registration of land change.

On December 12, 2001, the Dazhou Land and Resources Bureau issued the "State-Owned Land Use Certificate" No. Dazhou Shi Guo Yong (2001) Zi No. 3683, which stated: Land user: Dianshi Caixiao; Location: intersection of the west side of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province; Lot number: G/12/145-2; Use: enterprise construction land; Type of use right: transfer; Area of use right: 18,681.15 square meters.

In June 2002, the Dazhou Land and Resources Bureau issued the "Certificate of Other Rights over Land", which mainly stated: Rights holder: Business Department of Dazhou Branch, Agricultural Bank of China; Obligor: Dianshi Caixiao; Location: intersection of the west side of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province; Lot number: 6/12/145-2; Type of use right: transfer; Type and scope of other rights: mortgage established: 1. Land certificate number: Dazhou Shi Guo Yong (2001) Zi No. 3683; 2. Mortgage area: 18,681.15 square meters; 3. Mortgage amount: RMB 11 million; 4. Mortgage term: 3 years (from June 13, 2002 to June 12, 2005). Date of establishment: June 13, 2002. Duration: 3 years, expiration date: June 12, 2005.

On January 30, 2005, Dianshi Caixiao, through investment attraction, signed the "Investment Attraction Agreement" with Jufeng Company, valuing the land use right of approximately 18 mu (approximately 12,000 square meters) of land located at the intersection of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province as investment and cooperating with Jufeng Company in construction.

On March 15, 2005, Dianshi Caixiao and Jufeng Company signed the "Agreement on Joint Development and Investment for the Construction of the Street-Facing Part of the New West Campus", which stipulated that Dianshi Caixiao would invest the use right of the land of approximately 8,422 square meters located at the intersection of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province, which was commercial and residential land (approximately 12 mu of newly added land due to changes in road planning, and approximately 6 mu of the remaining land under the approval of Da Shi Fu Tu Han [2001] No. 75), and would not bear the profit or loss risks of the project investment or the responsibility for sales; Jufeng Company would raise the funds required for the project construction and be responsible for the development, construction, and real estate sales of the project.

On September 23, 2005, Dianshi Caixiao submitted Da Zhou Dian Da Xiao Fa (2005) No. 17, the "Request for Change of Land Use Purpose" to the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, which mainly stated: The school had acquired 63.12 mu of land in three batches in Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province, of which 35.12 mu was changed from allocated land to transferred land (28 mu according to mortgage loan requirements). Due to the planning adjustment by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, more than 10 mu of land (including land occupied by roads) along the edge of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road at the new base of Dianshi Caixiao in Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province had not been comprehensively utilized. In order to maximize the benefits of land resources, Dianshi Caixiao decided to change the land use of this more than 10 mu of land from educational land to commercial and residential comprehensive land for comprehensive utilization.

On November 3, 2005, the Dazhou Education Bureau, the Dazhou Land and Resources Bureau, and the Dazhou Planning and Construction Bureau submitted Da Shi Guo Tu Zi Fa [2005] No. 350, the "Request for Instructions on Changing the Nature of Part of the Land of the Municipal Radio and Television University's New West Campus" to the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, which mainly stated: Based on the instructions of the leaders of the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, the following request is submitted: Dianshi Caixiao had acquired 63.12 mu of land in three batches in Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province to build a new campus. After seven years of construction, new teaching buildings had been built, and facilities such as basketball courts were being constructed through fund-raising by investment attraction. In 2002, the alignment of the south extension line of the North-South Trunk Road in Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province was adjusted, and Dianshi Caixiao acquired approximately 8,400 square meters of additional land and paid the use fee at the allocated land price. Since the full-scale start of the new campus construction at the end of 2001, Dianshi Caixiao had raised funds through investment attraction with the approval of the Dazhou Municipal People's Government. According to the requirements of the Dazhou Branch of the Agricultural Bank of China, only land obtained through transfer could be used for mortgage loans. The Dazhou Municipal People's Government, through Document No. 75 of Da Shi Fu Tu Han, approved Dianshi Caixiao to retroactively complete the procedures for changing 28 mu of land from allocation to transfer, thereby obtaining a loan of RMB 20 million. Now, Dianshi Caixiao again applies to retroactively pay the land transfer fee for approximately 12 mu of allocated land and change the land use purpose to commercial and residential land, to be used as collateral for a loan application. Given that Dianshi Caixiao had already obtained the use right of approximately 12 mu of land through allocation, it is specifically recommended: 1. Approve the adjustment of land use purpose to commercial and residential land. 2. Since the alignment of the North-South Trunk Road was adjusted, the approximately 12 mu of newly added land had been allocated to Dianshi Caixiao for use, and due to the wedge-shaped land parcel that cannot be used independently, it is recommended to refer to the auction transaction price of adjacent land parcels for retroactive payment of the land transfer fee and handle the land change procedures according to law.

On January 11, 2006, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government issued Da Shi Fu Han [2006] No. 6, the "Reply on Approving Dazhou Radio and Television University to Retroactively Complete the Procedures for Land Transfer of Part of the Allocated Land" to the Dazhou Education Bureau, the Dazhou Land and Resources Bureau, and the Dazhou Planning and Construction Bureau, which mainly stated: Da Shi Guo Tu Zi Fa [2005] No. 350 has been received. After study by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, the reply is as follows: 1. Approve Dianshi Caixiao to handle land transfer procedures according to law for the land of 8,422 square meters located at the intersection of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province, for which the allocated land use right had been obtained. The land boundary shall be based on the "Cadastral Map" No. 2005-189 drawn by the Dazhou Land Survey and Planning Team of Sichuan Province in May 2005. 2. Dianshi Caixiao shall retroactively handle the land transfer procedures for this parcel of land according to law. The land transfer fee shall be retroactively paid with reference to the auction transaction price of adjacent land parcels, and the price difference shall be fair and reasonable and reported to the Dazhou Municipal People's Government for approval.

On January 11, 2007, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government issued Da Shi Fu Han [2007] No. 3, the "Reply on Dazhou Radio and Television University's Retroactive Handling of Land Transfer Procedures" to the Dazhou Land and Resources Bureau, which mainly stated: Approved Dianshi Caixiao to retroactively handle the transfer procedures for 8,056.20 square meters of land located at the intersection of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province, and to retroactively pay the land transfer fee. Approved the transfer of the transferred land use right of 365.80 square meters from Sichuan Jindu Hengyuan Industrial Co., Ltd. to Dianshi Caixiao. The land boundaries are all based on the "Cadastral Map" No. 2005-189 drawn by the Dazhou Land Survey and Planning Team of Sichuan Province in May 2005.

On March 7, 2007, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government issued the "State-Owned Land Use Certificate" No. Dazhou Shi Guo Yong (2007) Di No. 01499 to Dianshi Caixiao, located at the intersection of Jinshan Road and North-South Trunk Road, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province, lot number: 7/7/2-500, map number: 2005-189, land type: commercial and residential comprehensive land, type of use right: transfer, area of use right: 8,422 square meters.

On January 28, 2008, Da Shi Fu Yue [2008] No. 6, the "Meeting Minutes on Researching the Sale of Street-Facing Land of Dazhou Radio and Television University and Finance and Trade School to Resolve School Debts", mainly stated: The meeting requested: (1) The matter of Dianshi Caixiao selling street-facing land for development to resolve school debts was formed on the basis that Dianshi Caixiao had already signed a contract with the developer and the developer had fully paid the land transfer fee, which was essentially different from general development projects. All relevant functional departments should ensure the smooth implementation of the project. (2) According to the requirements of the leaders of the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, Dianshi Caixiao should negotiate again with the developer to strive for greater benefits for the school. (3) Dianshi Caixiao should take the lead in drafting a cooperation contract as soon as possible.

On March 15, 2008, Dianshi Caixiao and Jufeng Company signed the "Cooperative Development Agreement", which mainly stated: In order to resolve the debts of Dianshi Caixiao, in accordance with the spirit of Da Shi Fu Yue [2008] No. 6, the "Meeting Minutes on Researching the Sale of Street-Facing Land of Dazhou Radio and Television University and Finance and Trade School to Resolve School Debts", the parties reached the following agreement. 1. Name of the cooperative development project: Xuefu Mingyuan. 2. Project address: intersection of Jinshan South Road and North-South Street, Xiwai Town, Tongchuan District, Dazhou City, Sichuan Province. 3. Project scale: according to the "Campus Master Plan Adjustment Plan" approved by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government, the street-facing development and construction scale is 129,800 square meters (including 6,200 square meters of teaching space enjoyed by Dianshi Caixiao). 4. Cooperation method: Dianshi Caixiao invests the "Campus Master Plan Adjustment Plan" approved by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government and the transferred land use right of the street-facing land to be developed; Jufeng Company makes full cash investment and independently develops and constructs Xuefu Mingyuan. 5. Rights and obligations of Dianshi Caixiao: 1. Dianshi Caixiao has the right to obtain development benefits as agreed and does not bear the risks of project development and construction. 4. Transfer the land use right of the part to be independently developed by Jufeng Company in the "Campus Master Plan Adjustment Plan" approved by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government to Jufeng Company's name. 5. Ensure that the construction scale of Jufeng Company's project reaches 129,800 square meters. If the construction scale increases or decreases due to planning changes, within the range of 2% (inclusive) of the change, Dianshi Caixiao's benefits remain unchanged; if the change exceeds 2%, Dianshi Caixiao's benefits shall be adjusted proportionally. 7. Assist and cooperate with Jufeng Company in handling procedures such as land transfer. 6. Rights and obligations of Jufeng Company: 1. Has the right to enjoy development benefits as agreed. 2. Has the right to accept the transfer of the street-facing land use right of Dianshi Caixiao according to the "Campus Master Plan Adjustment Plan" approved by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government. 3. Has the right to independently develop, independently sell, and independently bear the risks of development and construction. 4. Ensure the completion of the construction scale of 129,800 square meters as required by the design drawings and fulfill Dianshi Caixiao's benefits as agreed. 8. Profit distribution: 1. Dianshi Caixiao shares the following development benefits as agreed: (1) RMB 25 million; (2) 6,200 square meters of teaching space (2,900 square meters of library and laboratory building and 3,300 square meters of student apartment); (3) a 200-meter plastic-ring track sports field, with construction costs of RMB 2 million; if the cost is less than RMB 2 million, Jufeng Company shall make up the difference to Dianshi Caixiao; if the cost exceeds RMB 2 million, Dianshi Caixiao shall pay the excess. 2. Jufeng Company enjoys the remaining profits after accepting the transferred land use right and paying Dianshi Caixiao the development benefits. 9. Method of realizing the interests of the parties: 1. The RMB 25 million benefit enjoyed by Dianshi Caixiao shall be paid by Jufeng Company in the following manner: Jufeng Company shall make an initial payment of RMB 5 million in cash to Dianshi Caixiao after the contract is signed and before the land use right is transferred; within 6 months after the initial payment is made, Jufeng Company shall pay another RMB 5 million in cash to Dianshi Caixiao; within 18 months after the initial payment is made, Jufeng Company shall pay another RMB 5 million in cash to Dianshi Caixiao, ensuring that the total amount of the RMB 25 million realized by Dianshi Caixiao reaches RMB 23 million. The remaining RMB 2 million shall be paid by Jufeng Company to Dianshi Caixiao within 24 months after the initial payment is made. 3. Jufeng Company's interests shall be realized after fulfilling Dianshi Caixiao's interests and paying relevant development and construction taxes and fees, and Jufeng Company shall accept the transfer of the land use right as agreed. 4. Time limit for handling land use right transfer: Dianshi Caixiao shall handle the procedures for the transfer of the land use right within twenty days after Jufeng Company pays the initial payment. 10. Other agreements of the parties: 1. If Jufeng Company fails to timely realize Dianshi Caixiao's interests as agreed in Article 9(1), it shall be deemed as breach of contract, and Dianshi Caixiao may rescind the contract. 5. This agreement is the formal contract text for the parties' cooperative development. If any previous agreements signed by Dianshi Caixiao and Jufeng Company are inconsistent with this agreement, this agreement shall prevail. The contract also stipulated matters such as drawings and construction period, liability for breach of contract, etc.

On May 9, 2011, Dianshi Caixiao issued Da Dian Da Cai Xiao Han [2010] No. 3, the "Notice of Rescission" to Jufeng Company, which mainly stated: On June 22, 2010, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government held a special meeting to conduct transparent operations for the sale of the school's street-facing land through public auction, listing, and bidding. Therefore, the school could no longer perform the "Cooperative Development Agreement" and decided to rescind this agreement. Please send personnel to Dianshi Caixiao as soon as possible to handle relevant procedures, carry out liquidation work, clarify accounts, and deal with aftermath matters.

On November 17, 2011, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government published the "Announcement on Cancelling Land Use Certificates" in the "Dazhou Daily", which mainly stated: According to the provisions of the Law of the People's Republic of China on the Administration of Urban Real Estate (hereinafter referred to as the Urban Real Estate Administration Law) and other laws and regulations, and in accordance with the spirit of the special meeting of the Municipal Government on October 27, 2011, it was decided to cancel the land use certificates No. Dazhou Shi Guo Yong [2007] Di No. 01499 and No. Dazhou Shi Guo Yong [2001] Zi No. 3683 within the IIF3-1-b plot of the Municipal Radio and Television University, and the said land use certificates were declared void.

During the first instance trial, on April 27, 2012, Dianshi Caixiao issued Da Dian Da Xiao Fa [2012] No. 25, the "Notice of Rescission" to Jufeng Company, notifying the rescission of the contract on the grounds that Jufeng Company had failed to pay the initial payment of RMB 5 million on time, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government had not approved the "Campus Master Plan" making the contract impossible to perform, and the Dazhou Municipal People's Government had requested the recovery of the land.

At the first instance trial, Dianshi Caixiao confirmed that after signing the "Cooperative Development Agreement", Jufeng Company had made payments totaling RMB 5,717,000.

On September 14 and 26, 2012, the court of first instance organized both parties to appear in court regarding the fact that the "Cooperative Development Agreement" could no longer be performed and whether Jufeng Company would change its claims, and provided explanation to Jufeng Company. Jufeng Company submitted to the court a written "Explanation on Whether to Change Claims" dated September 20, 2012, clearly stating that it would not change its claims. At the same time, it submitted to the court two "Civil Complaints", both marked "Copy Confirmed True on September 20, 2012" and stamped with the seal of the Intermediate People's Court of Dazhou City, Sichuan Province. The purpose was to prove that it had filed a lawsuit with the court within the statutory period to assert its rights and requested continued performance of the contract. One of the "Civil Complaints" was issued by Jufeng Company to the Intermediate People's Court of Dazhou City, Sichuan Province on May 11, 2010, and the other was issued by Jufeng Company to the court of first instance on November 6, 2011. Both "Civil Complaints" stated the same claim: to confirm that the "Cooperative Development Agreement" signed by Jufeng Company and Dianshi Caixiao on March 15, 2008, was valid and legally binding, and to order Dianshi Caixiao to strictly perform the contract as agreed.

Dianshi Caixiao argued that this evidence could not prove that Jufeng Company had filed a lawsuit with the court within the statutory period of objection to assert its rights, nor could it prove its claim. It clearly stated that it refused to cross-examine the above evidence submitted by Jufeng Company beyond the statutory period.

Jufeng Company filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance on February 28, 2012, requesting: 1. An order that Dianshi Caixiao compensate Jufeng Company for the economic losses of RMB 112 million caused by its unilateral rescission of the "Cooperative Development Agreement" signed with Jufeng Company on March 15, 2008 (initial investment of approximately RMB 32 million, minimum expected benefits of over RMB 80 million); 2. Dianshi Caixiao bear the litigation costs. On March 7, 2012, Jufeng Company submitted a "Application for Change of Claims" to the court of first instance, stating: Since Jufeng Company had invested a huge amount of funds in this project, rescission of the contract would cause significant economic losses, and therefore it applied to change the first claim to: an order that Dianshi Caixiao immediately and fully perform the "Cooperative Development Agreement" signed with Jufeng Company on March 15, 2008, confirming the cooperative development project with a scale of 129,800 square meters (initial investment of approximately RMB 32 million, expected benefits of not less than RMB 80 million).

电大财校答辩称：1.电大财校与聚丰公司签订的《合作开发协议书》约定电大财校只享有收益，不承担风险，该协议应为土地使用权转让合同，该转让行为因违反了法律的强制性规定而无效。 2. 假定双方签订的《合作开发协议书》没有违反法律的强制性规定，电大财校也有权按约行使解除权。聚丰公司未按协议第九条第一项的约定付清2300万元价款，故按约应解除《合作开发协议书》。 3. 假如《合作开发协议书》有效，电大财校也有权解除。达州市政府已决定将该宗土地收回整体处置，使双方的合同目的无法实现，故应解除《合作开发协议书》。且用于合作开发的国有土地使用权证已被达州市政府公告注销，双方无法履行合同，故应解除《合作开发协议书》。

Dazhou Radio and TV University (Dazhou Finance and Trade School) (hereinafter "Dazhou Radio and TV University") argued in its defense: 1. The Cooperative Development Agreement entered into by Dazhou Radio and TV University and Jufeng Company stipulated that Dazhou Radio and TV University only enjoyed benefits and did not bear risks; the agreement should be a contract for the assignment of land use rights, and such assignment was void for violating mandatory provisions of law. 2. Assuming the Cooperative Development Agreement entered into by the parties did not violate mandatory provisions of law, Dazhou Radio and TV University was also entitled to exercise its right of rescission in accordance with the agreement. Jufeng Company failed to pay the full amount of RMB 23 million in accordance with Article 9.1 of the agreement, so the Cooperative Development Agreement should be rescinded in accordance with the agreement. 3. Even if the Cooperative Development Agreement were valid, Dazhou Radio and TV University was entitled to rescind it. The Dazhou Municipal Government had decided to take back the land for overall disposal, making it impossible to achieve the contractual purpose of the parties, so the Cooperative Development Agreement should be rescinded. Moreover, the state-owned land use right certificate used for the cooperative development had been publicly cancelled by the Dazhou Municipal Government, and the parties could not perform the contract, so the Cooperative Development Agreement should be rescinded.

一审法院认为，关于合同性质及合同效力应如何认定问题。根据2008年3月15日电大财校与聚丰公司签订《合作开发协议书》约定的电大财校以达州市政府批准的《校园总体规划调整方案》及学校临街开发的部分土地使用权作为投资，聚丰公司以现金全额投资并独立开发建设学府铭苑，开发利润的分配等内容表明，电大财校与聚丰公司签订的《合作开发协议书》符合合资、合作开发房地产合同的法律特征，系合资、合作开发房地产合同。电大财校认为系土地使用权转让合同纠纷的抗辩理由不能成立，一审法院不予支持。《合作开发协议书》系双方当事人的真实意思表示，不违反法律、行政法规的强制性规定，不损害国家、集体或者第三人的利益，合法有效。

The court of first instance held that the issue of how to determine the nature and validity of the contract should be addressed. According to the Cooperative Development Agreement signed by Dazhou Radio and TV University and Jufeng Company on March 15, 2008, Dazhou Radio and TV University contributed as investment the Campus Overall Planning Adjustment Plan approved by the Dazhou Municipal Government and part of the land use rights of the school's street-front development, while Jufeng Company made full cash investment and independently developed and constructed Xuefu Mingyuan, and the profits from the development were to be distributed. These terms indicated that the Cooperative Development Agreement entered into by Dazhou Radio and TV University and Jufeng Company possessed the legal characteristics of a joint venture or cooperative real estate development contract and was a joint venture or cooperative real estate development contract. Dazhou Radio and TV University's defense argument that the dispute was over a land use right assignment contract could not stand and was not supported by the court of first instance. The Cooperative Development Agreement reflected the true intentions of the parties, did not violate mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations, did not harm the interests of the state, the collective, or any third party, and was lawful and valid.

关于双方签订的《合作开发协议书》是否应当继续履行，是否能够继续履行的问题。根据查明的事实，2011年5月9日电大财校以因政府拟对合作开发的土地重新进行拍卖，无法履行合作协议向聚丰公司发出《解除函》，通知聚丰公司解除合同。聚丰公司在《解除函》到达之日起三个月内并未向人民法院或者仲裁机构确认能否解除合同。根据《中华人民共和国合同法》（以下简称《合同法》）第九十六条第一款“当事人一方依照本法第九十三条第二款、第九十四条的规定主张解除合同的，应当通知对方。合同自通知到达对方时解除。对方有异议的，可以请求人民法院或者仲裁机构确认解除合同的效力”以及最高人民法院《关于适用〈中华人民共和国合同法〉若干问题的解释（二）》（以下简称合同法解释二）第二十四条“当事人对合同法第九十六条、第九十九条规定的合同解除或者债务抵销虽有异议，但在约定的异议期限届满后才提出异议并向人民法院起诉的，人民法院不予支持；当事人没有约定异议期间，在解除合同或者债务抵销通知到达之日起三个月以后才向人民法院起诉的，人民法院不予支持”之规定，《解除函》到达聚丰公司时就已发生法律效力，《合作开发协议书》已经解除。况且达州市政府已公告注销了双方合同项下土地的《国有土地使用权证》，在法律上或事实上也不能继续履行合同。为此，根据最高人民法院《关于民事诉讼证据的若干规定》（以下简称民事证据规定）第三十五条第一款“诉讼过程中，当事人主张的法律关系的性质或者民事行为的效力与人民法院根据案件事实作出的认定不一致的，不受本规定第三十四条规定的限制，人民法院应当告知当事人可以变更诉讼请求”的规定，一审法院向聚丰公司释明，告知其可以变更诉讼请求，但聚丰公司明确表明不变更诉讼请求，故一审法院对聚丰公司的诉讼请求予以驳回。

Regarding the issue of whether the Cooperative Development Agreement entered into by the parties should be further performed and whether it could be further performed: According to the facts found, on May 9, 2011, Dazhou Radio and TV University sent a Notice of Rescission to Jufeng Company, stating that because the government planned to re-auction the land for cooperative development, it was impossible to perform the cooperative agreement, and notified Jufeng Company of the rescission of the contract. Jufeng Company did not request the People's Court or an arbitration institution to confirm whether the rescission was valid within three months from the date the Notice of Rescission was received. Pursuant to Article 96, Paragraph 1 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter "Contract Law") which provides: "If a party asserts the rescission of a contract in accordance with Article 93, Paragraph 2, or Article 94 of this Law, it shall notify the other party. The contract is rescinded when the notice reaches the other party. If the other party objects, it may request the People's Court or an arbitration institution to confirm the validity of the rescission," and Article 24 of the Interpretation (II) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter "Interpretation II of the Contract Law") which provides: "Even if a party objects to the rescission of a contract or set-off of debts provided for in Articles 96 and 99 of the Contract Law, if it raises the objection and brings a lawsuit to the People's Court only after the agreed period for objection has expired, the People's Court shall not support it; if the parties do not agree on a period for objection and bring a lawsuit to the People's Court three months after the date the notice of rescission or set-off is received, the People's Court shall not support it," the Notice of Rescission had legal effect when it reached Jufeng Company, and the Cooperative Development Agreement was already rescinded. Moreover, the Dazhou Municipal Government had publicly cancelled the State-owned Land Use Right Certificate for the land under the parties' contract, making it legally or factually impossible to further perform the contract. To this end, pursuant to Article 35, Paragraph 1 of the Several Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Evidence in Civil Proceedings (hereinafter "Civil Evidence Provisions"), which provides: "During litigation, if the nature of the legal relationship asserted by a party or the validity of a civil act is inconsistent with the determination made by the People's Court based on the facts of the case, the restrictions in Article 34 of these Provisions shall not apply, and the People's Court shall inform the party that it may change its claims," the court of first instance explained to Jufeng Company and informed it that it could change its claims. However, Jufeng Company expressly stated that it would not change its claims. Therefore, the court of first instance rejected Jufeng Company's claims.

关于聚丰公司在一审法院释明后，向一审法院提供的2010年5月11日、2011年11月6日的《民事起诉状》问题。根据民事证据规定第三十四条第一款、第二款“当事人应当在举证期限内向人民法院提交证据材料，当事人在举证期限内不提交的，视为放弃举证权利。对于当事人逾期提交的证据材料，人民法院审理时不组织质证。但对方当事人同意质证的除外”的规定，电大财校明确拒绝对聚丰公司超过法定举证期限提交的上述证据予以质证，故一审法院不组织质证。一审法院认为，该证据复印件不能证明聚丰公司在法定期限内已向人民法院提起诉讼，也不能证明人民法院在法定期限内对聚丰公司的起诉立案受理的事实。经查证《民事起诉状》载明的起诉请求为确认《合作开发协议书》有效，双方继续履行合同，并不是请求撤销合同解除行为，或者确认解除合同行为无效。聚丰公司提供的两份《民事起诉状》不能证明其主张，一审法院不予采信。

Regarding the issue of the Civil Complaints dated May 11, 2010, and November 6, 2011, which Jufeng Company submitted to the court of first instance after the latter provided explanations: Pursuant to Article 34, Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Civil Evidence Provisions, which provide: "A party shall submit evidentiary materials to the People's Court within the period for producing evidence. If a party fails to submit within the period for producing evidence, it shall be deemed to have waived the right to produce evidence. For evidentiary materials submitted by a party beyond the time limit, the People's Court shall not organize cross-examination during trial, unless the other party agrees to cross-examination." Dazhou Radio and TV University expressly refused to cross-examine the above-mentioned evidence submitted by Jufeng Company beyond the statutory period for producing evidence, so the court of first instance did not organize cross-examination. The court of first instance held that the copies of this evidence could not prove that Jufeng Company had filed a lawsuit with the People's Court within the statutory period, nor could they prove that the People's Court had accepted Jufeng Company's lawsuit within the statutory period. Upon verification, the claims stated in the Civil Complaints were for confirmation of the validity of the Cooperative Development Agreement and for the parties to continue performing the contract, not for revocation of the contract rescission or for confirmation that the rescission was invalid. The two Civil Complaints submitted by Jufeng Company could not prove its assertions and were not accepted by the court of first instance.

一审法院依照《合同法》第四十四条第一款、第九十六条第一款，合同法解释二第二十四条，民事证据规定第二条、第三十四条第一款、第二款、第三十五条第一款，《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第九条、第一百三十八条之规定，判决：驳回聚丰公司的诉讼请求。案件受理费601 800元，由聚丰公司负担。

In accordance with Article 44, Paragraph 1; Article 96, Paragraph 1 of the Contract Law; Article 24 of Interpretation II of the Contract Law; Articles 2, 34, Paragraphs 1 and 2, and 35, Paragraph 1 of the Civil Evidence Provisions; and Articles 9 and 138 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the court of first instance rendered judgment: Jufeng Company's claims were dismissed. The case acceptance fee of RMB 601,800 was to be borne by Jufeng Company.

聚丰公司不服一审判决，向本院提起上诉称，1.电大财校解除合同的理由既非约定，也不符合法律规定，其在诉讼中的合同解除行为否定了诉讼前的解除行为，双方合同并未解除，应当继续履行；2. 聚丰公司已经依法向达州市中级人民法院提起诉讼，一审法院对此不予确认，认定事实不清，适用法律错误；3. 双方之间的合作关系不止表现为《合作开发协议》，即使《合作开发协议》解除，也不能终止双方合作开发房地产的权利义务；4.达州市政府无权收回双方合同项下的土地使用权，更无权注销该土地的国有土地使用证，其违法侵权行为最多只是中止而不是终止合同履行，且涉案土地使用权仍然在电大财校名下，该土地保持现状，双方合同没有到无法履行的程度；5.电大财校和达州市政府违反诚实信用原则，应当受到法律制裁。故请求：1. 撤销（2012）川民初字第11号民事判决；2. 判令电大财校立即全面履行与聚丰公司2008年3月15日签订的《合作开发协议书》；3. 一、二审诉讼费用由电大财校承担。

Jufeng Company disagreed with the judgment of the first instance and appealed to this Court, arguing that: 1. The grounds for Dazhou Radio and TV University's rescission of the contract were neither as agreed nor in compliance with legal provisions; its act of rescinding the contract during litigation negated its act of rescission before litigation; the contract between the parties had not been rescinded and should be further performed; 2. Jufeng Company had lawfully filed a lawsuit with the Intermediate People's Court of Dazhou City, but the court of first instance failed to confirm this, resulting in unclear findings of fact and erroneous application of law; 3. The cooperative relationship between the parties was not limited to the Cooperative Development Agreement; even if the Cooperative Development Agreement were rescinded, it could not terminate the parties' rights and obligations regarding cooperative real estate development; 4. The Dazhou Municipal Government had no right to take back the land use rights under the parties' contract, let alone cancel the state-owned land use right certificate for the land; its illegal infringing acts could at most suspend rather than terminate the performance of the contract; moreover, the land use rights in question remained in the name of Dazhou Radio and TV University, the land remained in its current state, and the parties' contract had not reached a point where performance was impossible; 5. Dazhou Radio and TV University and the Dazhou Municipal Government violated the principle of good faith and should be subject to legal sanctions. Therefore, Jufeng Company requested: 1. Revocation of the Civil Judgment (2012) Chuan Min Chu Zi No. 11; 2. An order that Dazhou Radio and TV University immediately and fully perform the Cooperative Development Agreement signed with Jufeng Company on March 15, 2008; 3. The costs of the first and second instance trials to be borne by Dazhou Radio and TV University.

电大财校答辩称，1. 双方签订的《合作开发协议书》性质是土地使用权转让合同，该合同违反了《国有资产评估管理办法》第三条第（一）项、《城镇国有土地使用权出让和转让暂行条例》第十九条、《城市房地产管理法》第三十九条，且该土地使用权没有通过招、拍、挂的方式转让，也违反了《事业单位国有资产管理暂行办法》第二十八条的规定，因此，该合作开发协议应当认定无效；2. 聚丰公司没有在收到电大财校《解除合同函》之日起三个月内对该解除函提出异议并向人民法院起诉，如果人民法院认定协议有效，电大财校解除《合作开发协议书》符合约定解除权和法定解除权的条件；3、达州市国土资源局向电大财校发出了收回土地的函告，达州市政府已经依法注销了合作开发的土地使用证，而用于合作开发的土地在政府出让的批文中已经明确仅用于抵押给银行贷款不能用于其他目的，且合作开发协议内容一直没有获政府相关部门受理，达州市政府2010年6月22日的专题会议上明确决定电大财校不能与任何单位和个人进行房地产合作开发，因此，合作开发协议已经无法实际履行。

Dazhou Radio and TV University argued in response that: 1. The nature of the Cooperative Development Agreement entered into by the parties was a contract for the assignment of land use rights; the contract violated Article 3(1) of the Measures for the Administration of Evaluation of State-owned Assets, Article 19 of the Interim Regulations on the Assignment and Transfer of Urban State-owned Land Use Rights, Article 39 of the Urban Real Estate Administration Law, and the land use rights were not transferred through bidding, auction, or listing, in violation of Article 28 of the Interim Measures for the Administration of State-owned Assets of Public Institutions; therefore, the cooperative development agreement should be found void; 2. Jufeng Company did not raise an objection to the Notice of Rescission and file a lawsuit with the People's Court within three months from the date of receipt of the Notice; if the People's Court finds the agreement valid, Dazhou Radio and TV University's rescission of the Cooperative Development Agreement satisfied the conditions for both contractual and statutory rights of rescission; 3. The Dazhou Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources sent a letter to Dazhou Radio and TV University regarding the taking back of the land; the Dazhou Municipal Government had lawfully cancelled the land use right certificate for the cooperative development; the land used for cooperative development, as clearly stated in the government's approval document for transfer, was only to be used as collateral for bank loans and not for other purposes; the content of the cooperative development agreement had never been accepted by relevant government departments; at a special meeting on June 22, 2010, the Dazhou Municipal Government explicitly decided that Dazhou Radio and TV University could not engage in real estate cooperative development with any unit or individual; therefore, the cooperative development agreement could not actually be performed.

本院二审另查明，二审诉讼期间，涉案土地的土地登记档案载明的权利人为达州市广播电视大学。

This Court further found during the second instance that, during the second instance proceedings, the rights holder recorded in the land registration archives for the land in question was Dazhou Radio and Television University.

本院认为，本案当事人争议的焦点问题是：1. 《合作开发协议书》性质和效力问题；2. 《合作开发协议书》是否解除；3. 《合作开发协议书》能否继续履行。

This Court holds that the issues in dispute between the parties in this case are: 1. The nature and validity of the Cooperative Development Agreement; 2. Whether the Cooperative Development Agreement has been rescinded; 3. Whether the Cooperative Development Agreement can be further performed.

（一）关于合同性质和效力问题。

(1) Regarding the nature and validity of the contract.

本院认为，涉案合同虽然冠以“合作开发协议书”之名，但合同中明确约定电大财校只享有固定开发收益，不承担开发经营的风险。根据最高人民法院《关于审理涉及国有土地使用权合同纠纷案件适用法律问题的解释》第二十四条“合作开发房地产合同约定提供土地使用权的当事人不承担经营风险，只收取固定利益的，应当认定为土地使用权转让合同”的规定，《合作开发协议书》性质为土地使用权转让合同。一审法院关于合同性质的认定有误，本院予以纠正。

This Court holds that although the contract in question is titled "Cooperative Development Agreement," the contract explicitly stipulates that Dazhou Radio and TV University only enjoys a fixed development benefit and does not bear the risk of development and operation. Pursuant to Article 24 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Disputes over Contracts Involving State-owned Land Use Rights, which provides: "If a cooperative real estate development contract stipulates that the party providing the land use rights does not bear operational risks and only receives fixed benefits, it shall be identified as a contract for the assignment of land use rights," the nature of the Cooperative Development Agreement is a contract for the assignment of land use rights. The court of first instance's determination of the contract's nature was erroneous, and this Court corrects it.

根据最高人民法院《关于适用〈中华人民共和国合同法〉若干问题的解释（一）》第四条 “合同法实施以后，人民法院确认合同无效，应当以全国人大及其常委会制定的法律和国务院制定的行政法规为依据，不得以地方性法规、行政规章为依据” 的规定，以及合同法解释二第十四条关于“合同法第五十二条第（五）项规定的‘强制性规定’，是指效力性强制性规定”的规定，因“违反法律、行政法规的强制性规定”而无效的合同，是指违反了法律、行政法规中的效力性强制性规定，法律、行政法规中的管理性强制性规定不能作为认定合同无效的依据。本案中，电大财校主张合同无效的理由是《合作开发协议书》违反了《国有资产评估管理办法》第三条第（一）项、《招标拍卖挂牌出让国有建设用地使用权规定》、《事业单位国有资产管理暂行办法》第二十八条，以及《城镇国有土地使用权出让和转让暂行条例》第十九条、《城市房地产管理法》第三十九条第二项的规定，但《国有资产评估管理办法》、《招标拍卖挂牌出让国有建设用地使用权规定》和《事业单位国有资产管理暂行办法》系行政规章，而《城市房地产管理法》第三十九条第二项、《城镇国有土地使用权出让和转让暂行条例》第十九条为法律、行政法规中的管理性强制性规定，均不能作为认定合同无效的依据。电大财校关于合同无效的主张，缺乏法律依据，本院不予支持。聚丰公司和电大财校之间订立的《合作开发协议书》是双方当事人真实的意思表示，不违反法律、行政法规的强制性规定，合同有效。

Pursuant to Article 4 of the Interpretation (I) of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Application of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, which provides: "After the implementation of the Contract Law, the People's Court shall determine whether a contract is void based on laws enacted by the National People's Congress and its Standing Committee and administrative regulations formulated by the State Council, and shall not rely on local regulations or administrative rules," and Article 14 of Interpretation II of the Contract Law, which provides: "The 'mandatory provisions' as stipulated in Article 52(5) of the Contract Law refer to mandatory provisions on validity." A contract that is void for "violating mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations" refers to contracts that violate mandatory provisions on validity in laws and administrative regulations; mandatory provisions on administration in laws and administrative regulations cannot be used as a basis for finding a contract void. In this case, Dazhou Radio and TV University's grounds for arguing that the contract is void are that the Cooperative Development Agreement violates Article 3(1) of the Measures for the Administration of Evaluation of State-owned Assets, the Provisions on the Assignment of State-owned Construction Land Use Rights through Bidding, Auction, and Listing, Article 28 of the Interim Measures for the Administration of State-owned Assets of Public Institutions, as well as Article 19 of the Interim Regulations on the Assignment and Transfer of Urban State-owned Land Use Rights, and Article 39, Paragraph 2 of the Urban Real Estate Administration Law. However, the Measures for the Administration of Evaluation of State-owned Assets, the Provisions on the Assignment of State-owned Construction Land Use Rights through Bidding, Auction, and Listing, and the Interim Measures for the Administration of State-owned Assets of Public Institutions are administrative rules, while Article 39, Paragraph 2 of the Urban Real Estate Administration Law and Article 19 of the Interim Regulations on the Assignment and Transfer of Urban State-owned Land Use Rights are mandatory provisions on administration in laws and administrative regulations. None of these can be used as a basis for finding the contract void. Dazhou Radio and TV University's assertion that the contract is void lacks legal basis and is not supported by this Court. The Cooperative Development Agreement entered into by Jufeng Company and Dazhou Radio and TV University reflects the true intentions of the parties, does not violate mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations, and is valid.

（二）关于《合作开发协议书》是否解除问题。

(2) Regarding whether the Cooperative Development Agreement has been rescinded.

本院认为，根据《合同法》第九十三条的规定，“当事人协商一致，可以解除合同。当事人可以约定一方解除合同的条件。解除合同的条件成就时，解除权人可以解除合同”。第九十四条规定，“有下列情形之一的，当事人可以解除合同：（一）因不可抗力致使不能实现合同目的；（二）在履行期限届满之前，当事人一方明确表示或者以自己的行为表明不履行主要债务；（三）当事人一方迟延履行主要债务，经催告后在合理期限内仍未履行；（四）当事人一方迟延履行债务或者有其他违约行为致使不能实现合同目的；（五）法律规定的其他情形”。本案中，双方在《合作开发协议》第十条中约定电大财校可以解除合同的条件为，“在乙方（聚丰公司）未按照本合同第九条第一款约定按期兑现甲方（电大财校）利益”以及“乙方（聚丰公司）违反合同第六条第七款之规定（即不得将本项目整体或部分转让给其他任何单位或个人开发）”。电大财校所主张的政府拟对合作开发的土地重新拍卖、无法履行合作协议的解除合同的理由，并非合同约定的电大财校可以解除合同的条件，也不属于《合同法》第九十四条可以行使法定解除权的情形。《合同法》第九十六条和合同法解释二第二十四条关于合同的约定解除和法定解除权利行使方式和期限的规定，不能适用于本案电大财校通知解除合同的情形。电大财校以《解除函》通知聚丰公司解除合同的行为，不发生解除合同的效力。一审判决根据《合同法》第九十六条和合同法解释二第二十四条的规定认定《合作开发协议书》已经解除，适用法律错误，本院予以纠正。

This Court holds that, pursuant to Article 93 of the Contract Law: "The parties may rescind the contract upon mutual agreement. The parties may agree on the conditions for one party to rescind the contract. When the conditions for rescission are met, the party with the right of rescission may rescind the contract." Article 94 provides: "The parties may rescind the contract under any of the following circumstances: (1) The purpose of the contract cannot be achieved due to force majeure; (2) Before the expiration of the performance period, one party expressly states or indicates by its conduct that it will not perform the main debt; (3) One party delays performance of the main debt and still fails to perform within a reasonable period after being demanded; (4) One party delays performance of its debts or commits other breaches of contract, making it impossible to achieve the purpose of the contract; (5) Other circumstances provided by law." In this case, the parties agreed in Article 10 of the Cooperative Development Agreement that the conditions for Dazhou Radio and TV University to rescind the contract were "if Party B (Jufeng Company) fails to timely realize Party A's (Dazhou Radio and TV University) benefits as provided in Article 9(1) of this contract" and "if Party B (Jufeng Company) violates Article 6(7) of the contract (i.e., it shall not assign the whole or part of this project to any other unit or individual for development)." Dazhou Radio and TV University's stated ground for rescission—that the government planned to re-auction the land for cooperative development, making it impossible to perform the cooperative agreement—was neither a condition agreed in the contract for Dazhou Radio and TV University's right to rescind nor a circumstance under Article 94 of the Contract Law allowing the exercise of a statutory right to rescind. The provisions of Article 96 of the Contract Law and Article 24 of Interpretation II of the Contract Law regarding the manner and time limit for exercising contractual and statutory rights of rescission do not apply to the situation in this case where Dazhou Radio and TV University notified rescission. Dazhou Radio and TV University's act of notifying Jufeng Company of rescission via the Notice of Rescission did not have the effect of rescinding the contract. The court of first instance's determination that the Cooperative Development Agreement had been rescinded based on Article 96 of the Contract Law and Article 24 of Interpretation II of the Contract Law was erroneous in application of law, and this Court corrects it.

（三）关于《合作开发协议书》能否继续履行问题。

(3) Regarding whether the Cooperative Development Agreement can be further performed.

2011年11月17日，达州市人民政府在《达州日报》刊登《关于注销土地使用证的公告》，注销了涉案土地的国有土地使用证。一审判决据此认定合同在法律上或事实上不能继续履行。电大财校在二审期间亦辩称，达州市国土资源局向其发出了收回土地的函告，达州市人民政府已经注销了土地使用权证，其“不再享有该宗土地使用权”，“双方合作开发房地产这行为丧失了履行合同的基础和条件，该协议书在客观上已经不能履行”。

On November 17, 2011, the Dazhou Municipal People's Government published a Public Notice on the Cancellation of Land Use Right Certificates in the Dazhou Daily, cancelling the state-owned land use right certificate for the land in question. The court of first instance accordingly determined that the contract could not be further performed as a matter of law or fact. During the second instance, Dazhou Radio and TV University also argued that the Dazhou Municipal Bureau of Land and Resources had sent a letter informing it of the taking back of the land, that the Dazhou Municipal People's Government had cancelled the land use right certificate, that it "no longer enjoys the land use rights for this parcel," and that "the parties' cooperative real estate development has lost the basis and conditions for contract performance; the agreement objectively cannot be performed."

本院认为，根据《中华人民共和国物权法》（以下简称《物权法》）第十四条的规定，“不动产物权的设立、变更、转让和消灭，依照法律规定应当登记的，自记载于不动产登记簿时发生效力”；第十七条规定，“不动产权属证书是权利人享有该不动产物权的证明。不动产权属证书记载的事项，应当与不动产登记簿一致；记载不一致的，除有证据证明不动产登记簿确有错误外，以不动产登记簿为准”。上述法律规定表明，不动产权利人的确定，应当以不动产登记簿的记载为依据。达州市人民政府虽然公告注销了作为涉案土地不动产物权证明的国有土地使用证，但并未注销土地登记，且至二审诉讼期间，涉案土地的土地登记档案中载明的权利人仍然是达州市广播电视大学。这一事实说明，达州市人民政府注销国有土地使用证的行为，并未改变涉案土地的权属状况。根据《中华人民共和国城镇国有土地使用权出让和转让暂行条例》第四十二条的规定，“国家对土地使用者依法取得的土地使用权不提前收回。在特殊情况下，根据社会公共利益的需要，国家可以依照法律程序提前收回，并根据土地使用者已使用的年限和开发、利用土地的实际情况给予相应的补偿”。《物权法》第四十二条、第四十四条也对为了公共利益以及因抢险、救灾等紧急需要，依照法律规定的权限和程序可以征收单位、个人的不动产作出规定。但迄今并无证据证明涉案土地已经被依法征收、征用的事实。综上，涉案土地使用权的权属并未发生变化，电大财校仍然是涉案土地使用权的权利人，《合作开发协议书》的履行不存在法律上的障碍，能够继续履行。

This Court holds that, pursuant to Article 14 of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter "Property Law"): "The creation, modification, transfer, and extinction of real property rights shall, if provided by law, become effective upon registration in the real property register." Article 17 provides: "The real property title certificate is proof that the holder enjoys the real property right. The matters recorded in the real property title certificate shall be consistent with the real property register; if they are inconsistent, the real property register shall prevail, unless there is evidence proving that the real property register is indeed erroneous." These legal provisions indicate that the determination of the holder of a real property right shall be based on the records in the real property register. Although the Dazhou Municipal People's Government publicly cancelled the state-owned land use right certificate, which served as proof of the real property right for the land in question, it did not cancel the land registration; moreover, as of the second instance proceedings, the rights holder recorded in the land registration archives for the land in question remained Dazhou Radio and Television University. This fact demonstrates that the cancellation of the state-owned land use right certificate by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government did not change the ownership status of the land in question. Pursuant to Article 42 of the Interim Regulations on the Assignment and Transfer of Urban State-owned Land Use Rights: "The State shall not prematurely recover land use rights lawfully obtained by land users. Under special circumstances, where required by the public interest, the State may, in accordance with legal procedures, prematurely recover such land use rights and shall provide corresponding compensation based on the number of years the land has been used by the land user and the actual circumstances of land development and utilization." Articles 42 and 44 of the Property Law also provide for the expropriation of real property of units and individuals for the public interest and for emergency needs such as rescue and disaster relief, in accordance with the powers and procedures prescribed by law. However, to date, there is no evidence proving that the land in question has been lawfully expropriated or requisitioned. In summary, the ownership of the land use rights for the land in question has not changed; Dazhou Radio and TV University remains the holder of the land use rights for the land in question; there is no legal obstacle to the performance of the Cooperative Development Agreement, and it can be further performed.

关于电大财校提出的涉案土地的政府出让批文中明确表示该宗土地仅用于抵押给银行贷款不能用于其他目的、合作开发协议书无法履行的抗辩，本院认为，2008年1月28日达市府阅〔2008〕6号《研究达州电大和财贸校临街出让土地化解学校债务的会议纪要》的内容已经表明，电大财校与聚丰公司就涉案土地进行合作开发已获达州市人民政府同意，电大财校的此项抗辩无事实依据，本院不予支持。关于电大财校提出的政府不可能受理审批《校园总体规划调整方案》、合作开发协议书不可能履行的抗辩，本院认为，政府是否受理审批《校园总体规划调整方案》系尚未确定的事实，以此作为合同不能实际履行的依据，缺乏事实基础，本院不予支持。

Regarding Dazhou Radio and TV University's defense that the government's approval document for the assignment of the land in question explicitly stated that the land was only to be used as collateral for bank loans and not for other purposes, and that the Cooperative Development Agreement cannot be performed, this Court holds that the content of the Meeting Minutes of the Study on the Assignment of Street-Front Land by Dazhou Radio and TV University and Finance and Trade School to Resolve School Debts (Da Shi Fu Yue [2008] No. 6) dated January 28, 2008, already indicates that the cooperative development of the land in question by Dazhou Radio and TV University and Jufeng Company was approved by the Dazhou Municipal People's Government. This defense by Dazhou Radio and TV University lacks factual basis and is not supported by this Court. Regarding Dazhou Radio and TV University's defense that the government would not accept or approve the Campus Overall Planning Adjustment Plan, and that the Cooperative Development Agreement cannot be performed, this Court holds that whether the government will accept and approve the Campus Overall Planning Adjustment Plan is an undetermined fact; using this as a basis for arguing that the contract cannot actually be performed lacks a factual foundation and is not supported by this Court.

综上所述，一审判决认定事实清楚，但适用法律错误。依照《中华人民共和国民事诉讼法》第一百七十条第一款第（二）项之规定，判决如下：

In summary, the court of first instance's findings of fact are clear, but its application of law is erroneous. Pursuant to Article 170, Paragraph 1, Item (2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

一、撤销四川省高级人民法院于2012年10月24日作出（2012）川民初字第11号民事判决；

1. The Civil Judgment (2012) Chuan Min Chu Zi No. 11 rendered by the Sichuan High People's Court on October 24, 2012, is hereby revoked;

二、达州广播电视大学（达州财贸学校）继续履行与四川省聚丰房地产开发有限责任公司2008年3月15日签订的《合作开发协议书》。

2. Dazhou Radio and Television University (Dazhou Finance and Trade School) shall continue to perform the Cooperative Development Agreement signed with Sichuan Jufeng Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. on March 15, 2008.

一审案件受理费601800元、二审案件受理费601800元，均由达州广播电视大学（达州财贸学校）负担。

The case acceptance fees for the first instance, RMB 601,800, and for the second instance, RMB 601,800, shall be borne by Dazhou Radio and Television University (Dazhou Finance and Trade School).

本判决为终审判决。

This judgment is final.
